plan.title: Reverse auction auto-title for two locations

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Switch the event type from the default RFP to Auction.
Choose the reverse buy-auction template so the pricing sheet is available.
Add two rows for the specified product.
Set the first product row to Plant Name.
Set the second product row to Gurgaon.

Restore the second location so the event again has two locations.
